# @mission-platform/components

Vue 3 component library for Mission Platform. A comprehensive collection of reusable, accessible, and responsive UI components.

## Features

### Base Components (100+)

The package provides over 100 Vue 3 components with consistent styling and behavior:

#### Form Controls
- `BaseButton` — Button component with variants (primary, secondary, ghost) and sizes
- `BaseIconButton` — Compact, square, icon-only button (ghost/primary/secondary/danger variants, sm/md/lg sizes) with a required `label` for accessibility; used for close controls, toolbar actions, and chip removal
- `BaseInput`, `BaseTextarea` — Text input components with validation states
- `BaseSelect`, `BaseMultiselect` — Dropdown selection components, each backed by a visually-hidden native `<select>` (`<select multiple>` for `BaseMultiselect`) so browser/profile-manager autofill works and the value is submitted in a native form; expose `name` and `autocomplete` props
- `BaseCheckbox`, `BaseRadio`, `BaseSwitch` — Single/multi-state inputs
- `BaseRating` — Star rating input/display (`v-model`) with whole or half-star precision (`allowHalf`), interactive `role="slider"` mode (arrow/Home/End keys) vs. read-only `role="img"` display, hover preview, `clearable`, and `sm`/`md`/`lg` sizes
- `BaseSlider` — Range slider (`v-model`) with `min`/`max`/`step` rounding, drag and full keyboard control (arrows, PageUp/Down, Home/End), an optional value tooltip (`showValue`/`formatValue`), and `sm`/`md`/`lg` sizes
- `BaseRangeInput` — Dual-thumb min/max range selector (`v-model`) with ordered, non-crossing thumbs and an optional `minDistance`
- `BaseOtpInput` — Segmented one-time-password / verification-code field with auto-advance, paste distribution, masking, and character-set validation, wrapped in a semantic `<fieldset>`
- `BaseDateInput`, `BaseTimeInput`, `BaseDateRangeInput` — Date/time pickers
- `BaseColorInput` — Color picker component
- `BaseFileInput` — File upload input with preview support
- `BaseSearchInput` — Search input with debounce and clear functionality
- `BaseMarkdownInput` — Markdown editor using Monaco Editor
- `BaseLocationInput` — Location/geocoding input with coordinate support

#### Data Display
- `BaseTable`, `BaseVirtualTable` — Tables with sorting, pagination, virtualization
- `BaseList` — List component with variants and custom rendering
- `BaseBadge`, `BaseTag` — Status and category tags
- `BaseAvatar` — User avatar with status indicators
- `BaseStatusIcon` — Status indicator icons (success, warning, error)
- `BaseQuote` — Semantic `<blockquote>` / pull-quote with optional author + source attribution, a `cite` URL, `default`/`bordered`/`plain` variants, and `sm`/`md`/`lg` sizes
- `BaseSkeleton` — Loading skeleton components
- `BaseSpinner` — Loading spinner with variants
- `BaseProgressBar` — Progress bar component
- `BaseCalendar` — Calendar view with month/week views (Scheduler)
- `BaseTimeline`, `BaseTimelineItem` — Ordered, chronological event list (vertical/horizontal, optional alternating layout) built from a semantic `<ol>`/`<li>`
- `BaseQrCode` — Scannable QR Code rendered as a compact SVG by a bundled, dependency-free encoder (byte mode, automatic version selection, lowest-penalty mask)

#### Feedback & Overlays
- `BaseDialog`, `BaseModal` — Dialog and modal windows with headers/footers
- `BaseDropdown` — Dropdown menu component
- `BasePopover` — Popover tooltip with arbitrary content
- `BaseTooltip` — Tooltip component
- `BaseCollapse`, `BaseAccordion` — Collapsible content areas
- `BaseTabs`, `BaseVirtualTabs` — Tabbed interface with virtualized tabs
- `BaseAlertBanner` — Inline alert/notification banner with `info`/`success`/`warning`/`error`/`neutral` intents, optional title, built-in status icon, dismiss button (`v-model` visibility), and an `actions` slot; uses `role="alert"`/`role="status"` appropriately
- `BaseToast`, `BaseToastContainer` — Toast notifications: `BaseToast` is the presentational card; `BaseToastContainer` renders the `useToast` store, teleported to `<body>` at one of six positions with enter/leave transitions and the `notification` z-index layer

#### Communication
- `BaseChatArea`, `BaseChatBubble` — Scrollable, auto-scrolling conversation surface and message bubbles (`start`/`end` sides, variants) using a semantic `<ul>`/`<li>`

#### Navigation
- `BaseNavbar`, `BaseNavbarItem` — Top navigation bar
- `BaseBreadcrumb` — Breadcrumb navigation
- `BasePagination` — Page navigation (`v-model:page`) with prev/next/edge controls and truncation ellipses; accepts `pageCount` or `total` + `pageSize`, configurable `siblingCount`/`boundaryCount`, and `sm`/`md`/`lg` sizes
- `BaseSegmentControl` — Single-select segmented switcher (`v-model`) backed by `role="radiogroup"` with roving tabindex and arrow/Home/End navigation, per-segment disable, and `fullWidth`
- `BaseDrawer` — Sliding panel anchored to a viewport edge via `placement` (`start`/`end` full-height side panels sized by width, `top`/`bottom` full-width panels sized by height); `overlay` (teleported, scrim-backed, `v-model:open`) or responsive `inline` (fixed-open above `inlineBreakpoint`) variants, named `2xs`–`2xl` `size` scale, optional draggable resize (axis-aware handle), and `closeOnBackdrop`/`closeOnRouteChange`
- `BaseMenu`, `BaseMenubar` — Menu components
- `BaseMenuItem`, `BaseMenuItemLink`, `BaseMenuItemButton` — Menu item variants
- `BaseFormWizard` — Multi-step form wizard

#### Layout & Display
- `BaseApplicationLayout` — Application shell with header, sidebar, footer
- `BaseVerticalLayout`, `BaseCard` — Layout containers and cards
- `BaseGrid` — CSS Grid layout primitive arranging content into a grid of `rows` (m) by `cols` (n), with a named `2xs`–`2xl` gap scale (mapped to `--mp-spacing-*` tokens) for `gap`/`rowGap`/`columnGap`, `justify`/`align` item-placement controls (`justify-items`/`align-items`), a scoped `cell` slot exposing per-cell `row`/`column`/`index`, and default-slot children that can span tracks via `grid-column`/`grid-row` `span`
- `BaseStack` — Flexbox stack layout primitive laying children out vertically (column) or horizontally (row) via `direction`, sharing the named `2xs`–`2xl` gap scale, with `justify` (`justify-content`), `align` (`align-items`), and `wrap` controls
- `BaseMasonry` — CSS multi-column masonry layout with fixed `columns` or responsive `minColumnWidth` and a named `2xs`–`2xl` gap scale
- `BaseTypography` — Typography utility component
- `BaseHero` — Page hero/banner with eyebrow/title/subtitle props, `media`/`actions` slots, `start`/`center`/`end` alignment, `sm`/`md`/`lg` padding, optional `fullHeight`, and a scrim `overlay` for full-bleed backgrounds
- `BaseSeparator` — Horizontal/vertical divider with `solid`/`dashed`/`dotted` variants, a spacing scale, an optional centred label slot, and `decorative` (presentational) support
- `BaseButtonGroup` — Groups related buttons into a single visual unit (`role="group"`), horizontal/vertical, with an `attached` mode that joins children's borders
- `BaseResponsiveImage` — Art-directed `<picture>` with format/media `sources`, native `srcset`/`sizes`, lazy loading, async decoding, fixed `aspectRatio` (avoids CLS), and `object-fit` control
- `BaseResponsiveVideo` — Responsive `<video>` with format `sources`, poster, playback flags, fixed `aspectRatio`, `object-fit`, and `play`/`pause`/`ended` events
- `BaseBackgroundVideo` — Decorative full-bleed autoplaying/muted/looping background video with overlaid content slot and optional scrim; honours `prefers-reduced-motion`
- `BaseCarousel` — Image/document carousel that never auto-rotates when `prefers-reduced-motion` is set, exposes an always-available accessible pause/play control while autoplaying (WCAG 2.2.2), and uses ≥24×24px indicator tap targets with a visible focus ring (WCAG 2.5.8 / 2.4.7)
- `BaseTreeView`, `BaseVirtualTreeView` — Tree view components with virtualization
- `BaseInPage` — Component that triggers callbacks when in viewport
- `BaseWindowPopout` — Window popout utility

#### Specialized Components
- `BaseMonacoEditor` — Monaco Editor wrapper for code editing (separate import)
- `BaseFormBuilder` — Dynamic form builder with drag-and-drop, with Editor, live Preview, and JSON Schema tabs (plus a wizard-only Steps tab for configuring steps)
- `BaseSchemaForm` — JSON Schema-driven forms with validation
- `BaseScheduler` — Calendar/scheduling component with event management
- `BaseVirtualLogViewer` — High-performance log viewer for large datasets

### Theme configuration
- `BaseThemeProvider` — Provider that creates and shares a reactive theme store (`useTheme`) with descendants; persists the preference to `localStorage`, pins `color-scheme` + a synced `<meta name="color-scheme">`, tracks the system color scheme, and exposes `theme`/`resolvedTheme`/`setTheme`/`toggleTheme`/`cycleTheme` as slot props. By default (`global`) it themes `<html>` via `data-theme`; set `:global="false"` to scope the theme to a rendered (`display: contents`) wrapper element (`as`, default `div`) for nested / per-subtree themes
- `BaseThemeToggle` — Control for switching `light`/`dark`/`auto`; backed by the shared `useTheme` store (so it persists, pins `color-scheme`/`<meta>`, and drives the surrounding `BaseThemeProvider`, global or subtree-scoped)
- `BaseThemeComposer` — Theme-attribute composer that configures the theme at runtime: maps friendly attributes (`primaryColor`/`primaryHoverColor`/`primaryActiveColor`, `secondaryColor`, `textColor`, `backgroundColor`, `surfaceColor`, `borderColor`, `focusColor`, `fontFamily`/`monoFontFamily`, `baseFontSize`, `radius`) plus an arbitrary `tokens` escape hatch onto `--mp-*` CSS custom properties; scopes them to its own (`display: contents`) wrapper by default or applies them globally to `<html>` when `global`, supports `v-model` on the config, optional `localStorage` persistence, and shares the store with descendants via `useThemeComposer` (exposed as slot props: `config`/`cssVariables`/`styleString`/`setConfig`/`setAttribute`/`setToken`/`removeToken`/`reset`)

### Composables

#### `useTheme()`

Access the shared theme store (provided by `BaseThemeProvider`, or a standalone singleton when no provider is present). The `createThemeStore` factory accepts `scoped`/`target` (theme a subtree element, assignable later via the returned `setTarget`) and `syncMeta` options.

```ts
import { useTheme } from '@mission-platform/components'

const { theme, resolvedTheme, setTheme, toggleTheme, cycleTheme } = useTheme()
```

To eliminate the flash of the wrong colour scheme, inline `themeInitScript()` as a
blocking `<script>` in the document `<head>` (before any stylesheet); it pins
`data-theme`/`color-scheme` from the persisted preference before first paint.

```ts
import { themeInitScript } from '@mission-platform/components'
// e.g. inject into index.html <head>: <script>{themeInitScript()}</script>
```

#### `useThemeComposer()`

Configure attributes of the theme at runtime. Returns the store shared by the nearest `BaseThemeComposer` (or a standalone singleton when no provider is present). Friendly attributes and raw `tokens` resolve to `--mp-*` CSS custom properties (`cssVariables`/`styleString`). Helpers `configToCssVariables`/`cssVariablesToString`, the `ATTRIBUTE_TO_CSS_VAR` map, and the `createThemeComposer` factory are also exported.

```ts
import { useThemeComposer } from '@mission-platform/components'

const { config, cssVariables, setAttribute, setToken, reset } = useThemeComposer()
setAttribute('primaryColor', '#0369a1')
setToken('radius-md', '1rem') // raw --mp-* override (prefix optional)
```

#### `useToast()`

Imperatively show/dismiss toast notifications (render a single `BaseToastContainer` to display them).

```ts
import { useToast } from '@mission-platform/components'

const toast = useToast()
toast.success('Saved!')
toast.error('Something went wrong', { duration: 0 }) // sticky until dismissed
```

#### `useId()`

Generate unique IDs for form accessibility.

```ts
import { useId } from '@mission-platform/components'

const id = useId() // unique ID like "radix-:id-1"
```

#### `useZIndex()`

Manage z-index layering for overlays.

```ts
import { useZIndex } from '@mission-platform/components'

const { current, next, increment, reset } = useZIndex()
```

#### `useRouterClose()`

Close modal/dialog via router navigation.

```ts
import { useRouterClose } from '@mission-platform/components'

const router = useRouter()
const close = useRouterClose(router)
```

#### `useReducedMotion()`

Reactively track the user's `prefers-reduced-motion` setting to gate JS-driven motion (SSR-safe). A one-off `prefersReducedMotion()` helper is also exported.

```ts
import { useReducedMotion } from '@mission-platform/components'

const reduced = useReducedMotion()
// e.g. skip autoplay / instant-scroll when `reduced.value` is true
```

### Special Import Paths

#### Monaco Editor Support

The `BaseMonacoEditor` component is exported via a dedicated subpath to avoid bundling Monaco language workers for apps that don't need code editing:

```ts
// Import for apps using Monaco Editor
import { BaseMonacoEditor } from '@mission-platform/components/monaco'
```

#### Styles Import

Component styles must be imported separately:

```scss
@use '@mission-platform/components/styles';
```

This bundle also ships a global `prefers-reduced-motion` reset (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 / 2.2.2) that collapses CSS animation/transition durations and disables smooth scrolling for users who request reduced motion.

### Type Definitions

All components export TypeScript types for props, emits, and configurations:

```ts
import type {
  ButtonVariant,
  ButtonSize,
  InputType,
  SelectOption,
  TableColumns,
} from '@mission-platform/components'
```

## Usage
